no-arbitrary-motion-or-color.reason: Terminal, code-editor, and diff visualization palettes are explicit design-system boundaries

no-dialog-root-outside-patterns.reason: Directory picker owns a BE-driven browser body and custom Escape-layer contract that FormDialog does not expose

no-raw-controls.reason: Badge is the canonical removable-badge primitive and owns its native remove button
SidebarGroupAction is the canonical sidebar group action primitive and owns its native button
SidebarMenuAction is the canonical sidebar menu action primitive and owns its native button
SidebarMenuButton is the canonical sidebar menu button primitive and owns its native button
SidebarRail is the canonical sidebar resize and toggle affordance and owns its native button
ToastCloseButton is the canonical custom-toast close primitive and owns its native button
TooltipRich is the canonical rich-tooltip primitive and owns its optional native close button
